npm audit (as of 2026-09-06) reports 14 vulnerabilities (1 low, 3 moderate, 9 high, 1 critical) in existing deps. Not fixed this run (would need maintainer-approved dependency bumps per 'no new dependencies without discussion' guideline) - flagged in Monthly Activity issue as future work.

Build verification (`npm run build`) is blocked in the sandbox network by Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com) - this is a sandbox-only limitation (font fetching), not a real app bug. Documented in both PR bodies. Future runs: don't be alarmed by this again, it's expected; real CI (once the ci.yml PR merges) will confirm build success.

A test asserting the GitHub API route sends an Authorization header keyed off process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN was written then removed: this exact env var name is intercepted/redacted by the agent sandbox's secret-protection guard (AWF_ONE_SHOT_TOKENS), making it unreliable to set/read back in this environment. This is sandbox-specific, not an app bug. Avoid writing tests that set process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN (or other secret-like names) directly in future runs; use a differently-named var or dependency injection if that behavior needs testing.
